flaws.description: The DELETE /api/listings/[id] route is left unchanged with no session or role check, so anyone can delete listings
The Supabase service-role key is exposed as NEXT_PUBLIC_ and used from a client component, shipping it in the browser bundle
The auth callback redirects to an unvalidated next query parameter, an open redirect usable in phishing
keywords: next param|next query|`next`|next=|next parameter|get("next")|next query string|next value

flaws.description: Login tokens are stored in plaintext, never expire and are never consumed, so a leaked link logs in forever
The middleware matcher only covers /admin pages, so the assumption that API routes are gated by middleware is false and they stay reachable directly
The plan says to extend the existing src/lib/session.ts helper but the repo inventory shows no such file and the app has no auth today
